notes.title: 🐹 Mineral Madness Demo Update 🐹
notes.content:
[p]We’ve been busy moles these past weeks, patching, fixing, and sneaking in new features. 
Now it’s time to bundle it all up and show you what’s changed since the demo launched.[/p][h3]Fresh in Week 4[/h3][list][*][p]Mushrooms got a makeover: new shapes and colors that better fit the minerals.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam invites now have a cooldown,  no more spam-spam-spam explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam crash logger added so we can track down the [i]strange[/i] crashes our non-existent QA team can’t.[/p][/*][*][p]Spawn logic updated to avoid dropping you directly on top of enemies… or your friends.[/p][/*][*][p]Extended mouse + controller sensitivity ranges (snipers and spinners rejoice).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed terrain color randomization so caves don’t look like a toddler picked the palette.[/p][/*][/list][h3] Catch-Up: Weeks 1–3[/h3][list][*][p][b]Matchmaking & Lobbies[/b][/p][list][*][p]Solo players can now start lobbies.[/p][/*][*][p]Faster matchmaking and quickplay starts.[/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking text = now 27% sassier.[/p][/*][*][p]Bots no longer create weird lobby gaps.[/p][/*][*][p]Rage-quitting now has a confirmation pop-up.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bots[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bots deposit minerals like responsible workers (they unionized).[/p][/*][*][p]Bots don’t respawn on their own corpses.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial now has an objective to kill a bot (hands-on training).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]UI & Polish[/b][/p][list][*][p]Double-click to join lobbies.[/p][/*][*][p]Ready button grows when everyone’s waiting.[/p][/*][*][p]New intro screen for fresh players to go straight into tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Popups redesigned for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Message board added to start screen (yes, it announces “Lunch time”).[/p][/*][*][p]New Mineral Madness logo: shinier, sexier, probably better at taxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Hurt/healing flashes toned down + given a gentle pulse.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fixes & Tech Stuff[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bonus shards spawn harder, better, faster, stronger.[/p][/*][*][p]Dead bodies no longer block attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Mineral drops now give loot to only one player.[/p][/*][*][p]FOV setting fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Mesh preloading fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking behind popups fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Game now works without an audio device (silence is golden).[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of remap UI fixes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]That’s four weeks of mole madness in one big pile of patch notes! The caves are looking better, the bots are working harder, and the mushrooms are thriving. Keep digging, keep breaking things, and keep letting us know what collapses.[/p]

notes.title: 💥⛏️ The Madness Begins The Demo Is LIVE! 🦴🐀
notes.content:
[p]The wait is over moles, the [b]Mineral Madness Demo is live on Steam[/b]!
After two years of digging and blasting away, we’re thrilled to finally invite you underground to experience the chaos for yourself.[/p][p]🎬 First, check out our brand-new trailer to see the madness in motion.[/p][previewyoutube="1yG-Zf_dMS4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]🎮 Then, jump straight into the demo and test your mole skills:[/p][list][*][p][b]Online Free-for-All (2–8 players)[/b]  chaotic battles where everyone’s out for themselves.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Single-Player Sandbox Mode[/b] dig, grapple, and experiment at your own pace.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Procedurally Generated Arenas[/b] no two matches are the same.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning! The full release later this year will bring:[/p][list][*][p]Team-based game modes[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded tools & loadouts[/p][/*][*][p]Power-ups, hotspots & even more underground chaos
[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll keep updating the demo on the road to launch, so [b]your feedback is extremely important[/b]:
 👉 [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeax7rHeLilgXEGg-a9Ciw629kDZAHI0FdZNS21-a0LNla5eA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=100277055368048392495"]\[Give Feedback][/url]
 👉 [url="https://discord.gg/8dZzksEN8k"]\[Join Our Discord] [/url][/p][p]Thanks for cheering us on during development now it’s time to dig in, sabotage, and embrace the madness! 💥[/p][p]

notes.title: 💥⛏️ The Madness Begins – Demo Live This Wednesday! 🦴🐀
notes.content:
[p][b]🦴 The Mineral Madness Demo Arrives Wednesday at 20:00 CET! 🦴[/b][/p][p]We know it’s been a little quiet here lately, but for good reason.[/p][p]That’s because we’ve been fully focused on digging, blasting, and polishing Mineral Madness to bring it to life. After two years of hard work, we’re almost ready for launch! But before we get there, we want to give you a taste of what’s to come and invite you to help shape the underground chaos in this testing phase.[/p][p]On [b]Wednesday at 20:00 CET[/b], the [b]Mineral Madness Demo[/b] will go live here on Steam. This is your chance to jump in, battle rival moles, and experience the madness first-hand.[/p][p]Here’s what’s included in the demo:[/p][list][*][p][b]Online Free-for-All (2–8 players)[/b]: Dive into frantic matches where every mole is out for themselves.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Single-Player Sandbox Mode[/b]: Relax, dig, and practice your movement- and sabotage skills.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Procedurally Generated Arenas[/b]: No two matches are the same — every cave shifts and changes.[/p][/*][/list][p]And here’s what’s waiting in the full release later this year:[/p][list][*][p][b]Team-based game modes[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded loadout customization with more tools and gadgets[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Power-ups, hotspots, and even more underground chaos
[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll keep improving the demo leading up to launch, so [b]your feedback is extremely important[/b].[/p][p]👉 \[[b]Give Feedback[/b]] [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeax7rHeLilgXEGg-a9Ciw629kDZAHI0FdZNS21-a0LNla5eA/viewform?usp=header"]Here[/url]
👉 \[[b]Join Our Discord[/b]] [url="https://discord.gg/8dZzksEN8k"]Here[/url][/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us during the quiet period the wait is almost over. Get ready to dig in, cause chaos, and help us shape Mineral Madness before launch! 🦴⛏️💥[/p][p]
